assessments.mechanism: Evaluate self-improvement as experience → reusable procedure → routing → held-out uptake, explicitly measuring negative transfer.
assessments.clean_scope: EvoAgentBench's Anchor Skill is a diagnostic curator-routed reference, not a deployable automatic method; automatic methods show strong configuration-dependent negative transfer.
assessments.o_comparison: O explicitly uses scoped Candidates, protected held-out/independent boundaries, and a precommitted recursive-routing comparison with zero genuine held-out observations. Thus the transfer/routing problem is known but the EvoAgentBench mechanism/effect is not directly evaluated.

assessments.mechanism: Treat autonomous meta-agent self-improvement as high-variance; require run-variance controls, held-out verification and policy/reward-hacking audits.
assessments.clean_scope: Meta-Agent Challenge evidence is a proxy for recursive self-improvement and shows substantial configuration/run variance and policy violations.
assessments.o_comparison: O has conservative Candidate/regression and evidence boundaries but no MAC-style autonomous meta-agent benchmark, variance analysis, or zero-resource red-team study.

assessments.mechanism: Two-timescale evolution of task skills and the improver/meta-skills themselves.
assessments.clean_scope: MetaSkill-Evolve held-out gains; exact marginal slow-loop/component ablations remain pending primary verification in the clean state.
assessments.o_comparison: No explicit fast task-skill plus slow analyzer/retriever/allocator/proposer/evolver meta-skill evolution loop was found in O.

assessments.mechanism: Keep persistent improvement in a curated external knowledge substrate while agent instances remain generic/stateless/disposable.
assessments.clean_scope: KSI quantitative cells still need some primary-table cross-check; evidence supports a persistent-object design, not universal effect size.
assessments.o_comparison: O already treats the repository as durable source of truth while execution/model context can reset; Episodes, Candidates, evidence and continuation persist separately from the current model session. It has not implemented/evaluated KSI's claim/forum/distillation substrate.

assessments.mechanism: Give an improver selective access to raw execution traces because compressed scores/summaries may destroy diagnostic signal.
assessments.clean_scope: Meta-Harness raw-trace ablation plus held-out transfer; TerminalBench specialization is weaker generalization evidence than classification/math.
assessments.o_comparison: O persists detailed raw invocation/tool events and durable fragments alongside compact Episodes/continuation, so the design premise is already present. It has not run a matched raw-trace versus summary-only self-improvement ablation.

assessments.mechanism: Bound self-improvement edits to one coherent component and accept only when train improves while hidden development performance does not regress.
assessments.clean_scope: AutoDesign paper-to-poster domain; strong attachment evidence but no direct one-component-versus-multi-component causal ablation.
assessments.o_comparison: O Candidates target scoped components, are inactive before evaluation, preserve rollback, and require protected regression/exact-head validation for activation. This partially matches bounded proposal plus no-regression acceptance, but O has not tested AutoDesign's hidden-dev proposer separation or one-component edit policy as a self-improvement loop.

assessments.mechanism: Use strict held-out selection and a safe empty/base fallback for self-evolving natural-language state; reject harmful candidates rather than accumulating them.
assessments.clean_scope: RSEA transfer evidence; the guarantee is only for its held-out validation distribution, especially with small/adaptively reused validation sets.
assessments.o_comparison: O has protected baseline regression, scoped/reversible Candidate activation, retained base components, and fresh held-out/independent execution boundaries. Its recursive routing experiment still has zero genuine held-out observations, so exact RSEA natural-language-state evolution is not evaluated.
